description: install of explicit items from a git source, fetched under the sync lock: a bare name's type found in the catalog, stored as `name@source` in that type's list after the config's own keys in their order, the sync installing it beside what the config declared; a typed name of a name two types share and a second item in one run; the same item again adds no second entry and the sync is up to date; --project creates the project config's `install` after its own keys and the project sync installs there.
